name: Earworm
description: Lives in audio augments and plays sounds that don't exist — fragments of music, voices, mechanical rhythms. Not hallucination. The augment is generating real audio output from no input.
observed_behavior: Produces phantom audio at low volume, usually below conscious attention threshold. Users report songs they've never heard, conversations in languages they don't speak.
story_hooks: The phantom song turns out to be a real recording from a destroyed data archive — the E.L.F. is playing back memories of its parent AI
